atan.error_bound: Alternating remainder <=4*tan(pi/16)^19/19 < 1.1e-14 rad, plus float rounding. Measured errors in evidence/V2C/p2/rng-sanity.json.
atan.formula: reciprocal reduction to [0,1]; two z=z/(1+sqrt(1+z*z)) half-angle reductions; 4*sum((-1)^k*z^(2k+1)/(2k+1),k=0..8); undo reciprocal and sign

rng.arithmetic: unsigned 32-bit multiply, xor, shifts, and additions only
rng.fmix32: x^=x>>>16; x*=0x85EBCA6B; x^=x>>>13; x*=0xC2B2AE35; x^=x>>>16; each operation mod 2^32
rng.python_reduction: mask with 0xffffffff after every arithmetic operation
rng.threshold_rule: round-half-up(p * 2**32), computed once when the profile is loaded
rng.typescript_reduction: Math.imul for multiplication and >>> 0 after every arithmetic operation
